Overview

York is a city in England with a population of 210,000. A beautifully preserved medieval walled city in Yorkshire, home to York Minster, the Shambles, and a rich Viking heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
